description:
FILED s518e (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-17) by Fable's ruling (s518, 11:0x): Type-Tiny does NOT join the board in s518e -- a board leg must stay ~20-30 min (it runs at every merge and in every agent's final legs), and Type-Tiny's 375 t-files at ~45 s each would add ~70 min at --jobs 4.  The one-time census by cause (s518e member 2) is recorded below; nothing is blessed for a dist that does not join.

THE MEASUREMENT THAT DECIDES THE TARGET (one typical file, t/21-types/Int.t, s518e tree, box load 3-9):
  transpile the t-file (pl2cl --no-cache)                      2.8 s
  run, module cache OFF (the board runner's *pcl-skip-cache*)  46.0 s
  run, module cache COLD                                       50.1 s
  run, module cache WARM                                       43.3 s
  perl, whole file                                              0.07 s
and the discriminator programs (runpcl, warm cache):
  `print "empty"`                                               0.2 s
  `use Types::Standard qw(Int); print "loaded"`                 45.8 s (49.5 cold)
  the same + 30 `Int->where(sub {...})->check` types            43.3 s
So (a) transpiling Type::Tiny's modules is NOT the cost (warm vs cold ~4 s; the module cache works), (c) the tests are NOT the cost (30 extra types add nothing measurable): it is (b) LOADING Types::Standard, which runs 113 string evals carrying 27,377 characters of generated Perl (counted under perl -d, keys `_<(eval N)` after `use Types::Standard qw(Int)`) -- ~0.38 s per eval string through PCL's eval path (transpile + SBCL compile), uncached across runs (a second warm run is not faster).

TARGET: the eval path's per-string cost (STATUS.md's Moo-class cost; the planned cheaper compile for eval strings -- e.g. the interpreter / a fasl cache keyed by eval text + captures).  Type-Tiny joins when a board leg including it stays under ~30 min: at ~5 s per file (the empty-program floor plus a cheap load) 375 files cost ~8 min at --jobs 4.

HOW TO RUN IT (tooling shipped s518e): `tools/cpan-scoreboard.pl --jobs 4 --timeout 120 "--dist-inc=$HOME/.cpan/build/Exporter-Tiny-1.006003/lib,$HOME/.cpan/build/Type-Tiny-2.010001/inc" ~/.cpan/build/Type-Tiny-2.010001` (the dist's own make test adds inc/; Exporter-Tiny is fetched, never installed); `--only=REGEX` runs a chunk; t-files are found recursively.  The dists-file line when it joins: `Type-Tiny-2.010001<TAB>--inc=Exporter-Tiny-1.006003/lib,Type-Tiny-2.010001/inc<TAB>sNNN<TAB>type constraints: closures, overload via stash entries, string-eval code generation`.

=== CENSUS BY CAUSE (s518e resume, Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18; RULED one-time census, Type-Tiny NOT joined) ===
Measured on the s518e tree after #3399-#3402 (4ba9c502, gen v2-6684), one t-file per run through tools/run-dist-t.pl (--inc Exporter-Tiny lib + the dist's inc/), the perl oracle = perl 5.40.3 on the same file from the dist root.  Scripts + raw per-file TSVs: worktree scratch/s518e/ (causes.sh, classify2.pl, fam.pl; census1-final.tsv, census3-final.tsv, censusS-final.tsv).

COVERAGE: chunk 1 (top level + 20-modules not Type-Tiny*/Types*, 126 files) and chunk 3 (21-types, 68 files) IN FULL; chunks 2 (20-modules/Type-Tiny*, Types*) and 4 (30-external, 40-bugs) by a SAMPLE (21 files, every 12th of the 249 not in chunk 1) -- the sample showed chunk 3 differs in kind (near-full files) and was run whole; chunks 2/4 repeat the chunk-1 families in the sample, so they were NOT run (215 files unmeasured, said here so it is not inferred).

PER FILE vs perl (215 measured):
  chunk 1 (126): SAME 14, SHORT 28, NONE 65, perl-skips-and-PCL-skips 17, perl-skips-PCL-ran 2.  Rows: perl ok 1,262 / PCL ok 249 (not-ok 30).
  chunk 3 (68):  SAME 30, SHORT 24, NONE 13, skip 1.  Rows: perl ok 5,577 / PCL ok 3,816 (not-ok 13).
  sample (21):   SAME 6, SHORT 7, NONE 5, skip 3.  Rows: perl ok 692 / PCL ok 562 (not-ok 3).
  (before the resume's fixes chunk 1 read PASS 13 / PARTIAL 20 / FAIL 93, rows 195 ok: the 93 were NOT one cause -- the first was #3399, then #3400 / #3401 / #3402.)

FAMILIES (NONE + SHORT files; rows = perl rows not reached + PCL not-ok):
files    rows  family
   50    1531  #3397 Pkg->m where Pkg is also a compile-time sub (Types::Standard::ArrayRef->inline_check / ->of)
    7     488  static-parse of run-time exports (`use Types::Standard -types`, detector; facts-overlay candidate, #3397 family)
   34     321  other / no fatal message (stopped short; PARTIAL counts)
   19     211  "Not a X reference" deaths (probed rt92571-2.t: `(Str | Str)` with `use Types::Standard -all` is a STRING bit-or "[~v" -- the static-parse family; the rest NOT probed one by one)
    4     167  compiler refusal (#3404 chained my / ~~ / statement not supported)
   12      93  #3405 a method named like a Test::More function (explain) is not found
    2      64  Test::Tester check_test (not provided by the PCL TAP layer; #1576 family)
   13      64  #1576 Test::More::subtest
    1      11  tie through a run-time-built class (Eval::TypeTiny::_TieHash / Type::Tie)
PARKED rulings (counted among rows that RAN): #233 caller fidelity 3 rows ($e->context->{line}, ->{file}, "line" option works); #2370 DESTROY 1 row ("closed over variables disappear on cue").  Rows behind a death are not attributed to them.
FIXED in this batch from the census: #3392 #3393 #3394 #3395 #3396 #3399 #3400 #3401 #3402.  FILED: #3397 (the biggest family), #3403, #3404, #3405.
NEXT LEVER by rows: #3397 (and its static-parse sibling: `use Types::Standard -types/-all` subs unknown at parse -- the facts-overlay candidate) owns ~2,000 of the ~2,950 missing rows measured.


=== s520a append (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18) -- one-file runs after #3397 / #3404 ===
On the s520a tree rebased onto MAIN-READY-29 (perl / base fd04c048-era / tree): t/21-types/ArrayRef.t 139 / 8 / 111, HashRef 131 / 73 (+1 fail) / 100, Map 124 / 115 / 115, Tuple 123 / 87 / 87, ScalarRef 88 / 76 / 76, Any.t (#3404: refused the whole file before) perl 72 / tree 69; tree only: Dict 140, StrMatch 79, CycleTuple 80 (after m0c).  Each file still stops short of perl's plan at a later cause; the census table above is otherwise unchanged (not re-run whole -- 43 s per file).
subject: Type-Tiny joins the CPAN board when a board leg including it stays under ~30 min -- today each of its 375 t-files costs ~45 s, and the cost is LOADING Types::Standard: 113 string evals (27 KB of generated Perl) at ~0.38 s each through PCL's eval path (the module cache and the tests themselves are not the cost)
